questions.label: Q1
questions.question: Does the file state that household contents were stolen or damaged by a theft outside the insured location that was neither a burglary (the thief forcibly entered the building or a room of it, or broke open a container in it, or unlocked it with the correct keys or codes that the thief had obtained by burglary or robbery; a vehicle is not a container) or a robbery (theft under threat or use of violence against the policyholder or a member of the household, or while they could not resist because of unconsciousness, accident or death; pickpocketing and trick theft are not robbery)?

questions.label: Q2
questions.question: Is a bicycle among the stolen or damaged items?

questions.label: Q3
questions.question: Does the policy, or the file, show that the policy does not include the separate supplementary insurance for simple theft away from home (einfacher Diebstahl auswärts)?

questions.label: Q4
questions.question: Does the file state that measures to reduce the loss are still to be taken (not yet carried out)?

questions.label: Q5
questions.question: Does the file state that the measures could not wait for the insurer's instruction because of imminent danger (Gefahr im Verzug)?

questions.label: Q6
questions.question: Does the file state that the original purchase vouchers for all of the stolen or damaged items cannot be obtained, or only at considerable cost (not even as a duplicate from the seller)?

questions.label: Q7
questions.question: Does the file state that traces of the theft (for example pry marks, a broken lock, window or container) have been removed or altered, or are to be removed or altered, by the policyholder or on their behalf, for example by repair or cleaning?

text:
Hello Ms Graf,

my bike has been stolen. It's a grey women's touring bike, an ordinary pedal bike, nothing electric, with two black panniers on the rack. I rode it to work every day for over a year, and honestly I feel a bit lost without it.

I know you'll want receipts, so let me say it straight away: I don't have any, for anything. I bought the bike second-hand from a private seller in September 2024 and paid cash, there was never a receipt. The panniers and the lock came with it. Nobody can give me a copy of something that never existed. The bike was worth about CHF 1,615 with the bags.

I do have the extra cover for simple theft away from home on my CSS policy. I added it in October 2024, right after I bought the bike, exactly because I was worried about this.

What happened: on Monday 26 January 2026 I left the bike at the racks by St. Gallen station at about 7.30 in the morning, locked with a cable lock to the rail as always. When I came back at 6 in the evening, the bike and bags were gone and the cable lock was lying on the ground, cut through.

I picked up the cut lock and brought it home. It's lying in my hallway exactly as I found it, I haven't thrown it away or done anything to it, in case someone wants to see it.

There's one thing I still need to do and haven't managed yet: register the frame number on one of the online stolen-bike lists and send the photo to the second-hand bike shops in town, in case it turns up. I'll get to it this weekend.

Thanks for looking into it.

Clara Wälti
Birkenweg 55, St. Gallen
